topic.source_contract: Water and wastewater developer-services capacity and connection evidence

facts.purpose: investigate network capacity issues for proposed development
facts.scope_guard: General service availability or an enquiry submission is not a capacity confirmation, connection agreement or infrastructure delivery.

facts.benefit: pre-planning enquiry can identify network capacity and avoid later delay
facts.scope_guard: A pre-planning process does not replace a candidate-specific response, planning condition, requisition or connection approval.

checks: does not limit repair or maintenance
facts.scope_guard: Mapped asset proximity is not legal easement, permission to build over or engineering approval.
An adoption route or application is not evidence that a sewer has been built, adopted or has spare capacity.

facts.capacity_principle: investment in new capacity where requirement and cost recovery are sufficiently evidenced
facts.scope_guard: Regulatory duties and service measures do not establish candidate connection, timing, price or network headroom.

scope_guards: A pre-planning enquiry is a process and is not a clean-water or wastewater capacity confirmation.
Water and wastewater capacity assessments remain distinct and are not inferred from each other.
Network asset proximity does not establish title, easement or permission to build over a sewer.
A Section 104 application or agreement is not evidence of construction, adoption or operation.
Ofwat connection duties and service measures do not prove candidate timing, cost or capacity.
A planning permission does not itself secure a water connection or network reinforcement.
Generic network guidance is not an executed hydraulic model or candidate-specific response.
No score or promotion is written without exact site demand, capacity response, connection/adoption evidence, planning and title relation.
